item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong evidence of personal anti-Muslim incitement and fear-mongering, but I did not find a comparably strong 2024 source showing Modi personally issued an explicit direct call for violence against journalists, civil society, or other non-Muslim groups. The record I found is mainly communal scapegoating and dehumanizing rhetoric, plus his denials.","evidence":[{"title":"India's Modi calls rivals pro-Muslim as election campaign changes tack","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"23 Apr 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/india/indias-modi-calls-rivals-pro-muslim-as-election-campaign-changes-tack/2053223/","summary":"Reuters reports Modi referred to Muslims as “infiltrators” who have “more children” and tied that claim to a warning that Congress would redistribute Hindu wealth to Muslims. This is direct evidence of personal scapegoating and communal othering.","question_ids":["3B.3","2B.6"]},{"title":"India: Hate Speech Fueled Modi’s Election Campaign","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"14 Aug 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/08/14/india-hate-speech-fueled-modis-election-campaign","summary":"HRW says Modi’s 2024 campaign frequently used hate speech against Muslims and other minorities, inciting discrimination, hostility, and violence. It also says he repeatedly raised fear that Muslims threatened Hindu faith, property, and women’s safety, which fits personal incitement through dehumanizing threat narratives.","question_ids":["3B.3","2B.6"]},{"title":"Indian PM Modi says he does not oppose Islam, Muslims as election campaign heats up","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"7 May 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/india/indian-pm-modi-says-he-does-not-oppose-islam-muslims-as-election-campaign-heats-up/2072917/","summary":"Modi denied opposing Islam or Muslims and said the day he starts “Hindu-Muslim” politics would be the day he becomes unfit for public life. This is counterevidence, but it is a denial rather than an independent corrective to the inflammatory record.","question_ids":["3B.3"]},{"title":"India's Modi denies stoking divisions to win election, files nomination","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"14 May 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/india/indias-modi-denies-stoking-divisions-to-win-election-files-nomination/2084849/","summary":"Modi again denied stoking Hindu-Muslim divisions and said he would not do “Hindu-Muslim” politics. This is the clearest official counterstatement in 2024, but it remains self-serving and does not offset the repeated communal rhetoric documented elsewhere.","question_ids":["3B.3"]}]}
